name: Vermin Infestation

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Infighting
traits.summary: Influence action: hinting that its parts conspire, with a DC 15 Charisma (Deception) success, deals it 10 Necrotic.
traits.text: As an Influence action, a creature that suggests the swarm's components are plotting against each other and succeeds on a DC 15 Charisma (Deception) check deals 10 Necrotic damage to the swarm.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climbs walls and ceilings with no ability check.
traits.text: The swarm climbs difficult surfaces, ceilings included, without an ability check.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.summary: Shares spaces with other creatures, fits through any Tiny-sized gap; can't heal or gain Temporary Hit Points.
traits.text: The swarm can move into and stay in another creature's space and vice versa, and passes through any opening wide enough for a Tiny creature. It can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Shred

params.when: start of the held creature's turn

actions.summary: +6, reach 5 or range 20/60, 4d4+4 Piercing (2d4+4 when Bloodied); a Medium or smaller target in its space is Grappled (escape DC 14, one at a time) and suffers a d6 effect each turn: 1-2 Poison and Poisoned, 3-4 Psychic, 5-6 Necrotic that also lowers max HP.
actions.text: Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) Piercing damage, or 9 (2d4 + 4) while the swarm is Bloodied. A Medium or smaller target in the swarm's space is Grappled (escape DC 14); the swarm holds one creature at a time. At the start of each of the held creature's turns, roll a d6. 1-2 Centipede Sting: 4 (1d8) Poison damage and Poisoned until the start of its next turn. 3-4 Pigeon Cry: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. 5-6 Weasel Drain: 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum drops by the damage taken.

summary: A quarrelling mass of centipedes, pigeons and weasels that strikes from range and in melee, then holds a victim in the churn and tortures them at random.
